Match only stable internal IDs produced in the Twitter platform and matching entity_type namespace, not platform-ID strings or display names. Preserve each table's data_source; account_twitter and tweet_twitter are distinct sources and must not be equated. Missing targets are allowed; this metadata creates no business foreign key.
